scenarios.title: The family looking for somewhere cosy

publicOpening.text: Are you familiar with Arabian Ranches? What are your requirements?
We're a family looking for a 5-bedroom house with a garden — we have two dogs — and a pool.
What's your budget?
Around 500k a year.
Options with a pool are limited, but I have a couple. When can you view?
We can move any time before mid-August. The kids start school then.
I'll line some up.
Ideally somewhere that doesn't feel like a rental — we want it to feel like a home.
